build_cython_extension: build the cymj Cython extension module for mujoco_py by calling load_cython_ext with the mujoco path
build_callback_function: build a C callback function from a string and return a function pointer using build_callback_fn
fix_shared_library: fix shared library rpath on Linux by removing and adding needed libraries with fix_shared_library
manually_link_libraries: manually link MuJoCo and GLFW libraries on Mac using install_name_tool via manually_link_libraries
ignore_mujoco_warnings: ignore mujoco warnings within a scope by using the ignore_mujoco_warnings context manager
